description: Network facts: the public IP address this service sees for you (client_ip), your User-Agent (user_agent), the country, city, coordinates and timezone of an IPv4 address from a local GeoLite2 database (reverse_ip), or the first IPv4 address a domain resolves to (domain_ip). value is the address or domain for the last two. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

value.description: An IPv4 address for reverse_ip, a domain name for domain_ip.

name: lookup_network
title: Network lookup
